metadata.title: Restore OpenTUI Backspace editing under Bun

work.objective: Fix the real Bun/OpenTUI composer regression where Backspace cannot delete typed text, without regressing printable input, Enter submit, completion, history, cursor movement or native textarea editing.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify the three allowlisted input-prompt files; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
Do not replace Unicode/code-point-safe native textarea deletion with manual JavaScript string slicing.

Preserve the global printable-key fallback only for genuinely printable input; control bytes and named editing/navigation keys must reach the focused textarea unless this component intentionally handles them.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed relative-path equivalent or report blocked.
context: User reproduced under QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun packages/cli/dist/index.js: typing works, but pressing Backspace does not remove characters.

Confirmed root-cause candidate in input-prompt.tsx: the global useKeyboard printable fallback runs before native textarea editing. Backspace arrives with name=backspace and sequence DEL (0x7f); the current condition accepts any non-ESC sequence, calls insertText(sequence), and preventDefault(), so TextareaRenderable never receives its default backspace action.

@opentui/core already merges custom keyBindings with defaultTextareaKeyBindings, including name=backspace action=backspace. The fix should stop swallowing non-printable editing keys rather than reimplementing the edit buffer.

Add a focused pure regression test for DEL/backspace classification, including printable ASCII, CJK/Unicode input, escape/control sequences, Delete and navigation keys. Keep the code easy to exercise from Bun.
The product acceptance remains real Bun behavior: input abc, press Backspace once, visible/editor content becomes ab, Enter submits ab.
nonGoals: Do not perform the visual parity redesign in this run.
Do not fix /help or runtime preflight in this run.
Do not change input history, completion ranking or multiline semantics beyond what is necessary for correct key routing.
